result.summary: Ekhart Distributors GmbH currently has no overdue invoices (three open invoices totaling €151k, all within terms). However, settled invoice history shows lateness increasing from 4 days to 0 days to 9 days late over three payments, a mild deteriorating trend. Credit exposure (€151k open) remains well within the €320k active limit, but the widening late-payment pattern warrants monitoring.
concerns: Only three settled invoices available, limiting statistical confidence in trend
Most recent settled invoice was paid 9 days late, the worst in the sample
Open invoice exposure (€151k) is approaching half of the €320k credit limit, so any slippage into late payment could pressure limit utilization
